notes: The Lighter Flotilla by day. The lighterman Xal-Jei (npc.mercantile-coast.lighter-flotilla.lighterman, 3905.0, 6357.6 at 10:00, his work socket at the quay end) sells his longboat, the one sea hull on this water (boat.lighter-flotilla.longboat, 2400 gold, moored at socket.lighter-flotilla.sea-hull-mooring 3865.9, 6364.77). He stands on the quay deck over the lighter berth. Staged on the deck 1.5 m off his west side (stage.at with his actor id; the scene tests the buy, not the walk along the quay), the camera aimed at him so the aim ray, not the nearest crewman, wins E (arbiter.ts aimedCandidate); then E, the boat window, Buy on the sea hull, the confirm naming the price against the purse, Buy pays; then the pause map with the longboat's pin as the player's. Who is near: the purser 6.3 m, the flotilla speaker 24.4 m; no hostile. Lit: the sky at 10:00.
